answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 31755 Country: Pakistan Title: I saw a dream that i am standing in front of the area of ablution in a mosque and most of my teeth break and fall down while standing. Question: I saw a dream that i am standing in front of the area of ablution in a mosque and most of my teeth break and fall down while standing. Please tell the meaning of this dream. I am an 18 year old boy. Answer ID: 31755 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 935/935/M=1432) If you saw in your dream that the teeth that you were collecting the teeth, that were falling down after breaking, in your palm or lap then it means that you would get your relatives together and save them from being separated. Moreover, some scholars have interpreted breaking tooth with paying debt. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
